title: Italian Egg Frittata
description: A simple Italian-inspired breakfast dish made with eggs, cheese, and vegetables. Perfect for a quick and easy morning meal.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat a tablespoon of oil over medium heat. Add the onion and mushroom and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the tomato to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Pour the egg mixture over the vegetables in the skillet.
Sprinkle the italian cheese over the top of the eggs.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the cheese is melted and golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve warm, garnished with additional cheese and herbs if desired.
